user.title: Connect to ARK Home
user.description: Enter the pairing code from the ARK Home workspace (Monitoring → system). This lets ARK Home watch this system's health and alert our team to problems. No camera images, locations or passwords are sent.

error.invalid_code: That pairing code wasn't recognised or has expired. Ask ARK Home for a new one.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach ARK Home. Check the internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This system is already connected to ARK Home.
